definitions.explanation: A formal or technical term for hair on the human head. Used in medical, scientific, and formal contexts rather than everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {毛髪|もうはつ}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had a hair analysis done.

examples.japanese: {毛髪|もうはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サンプル→サンプル：10939_sanpuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
⟦{加齢|かれい}→加齢：11821_karei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{毛髪|もうはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}する→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The amount of hair may decrease with aging.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal and technical term for head hair. In everyday speech, ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ or ⟦{髪|かみ}の{毛|け}→髪の毛：02619_kaminoke⟧ is used instead. {毛髪|もうはつ} appears in medical, scientific, and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毛髪|もうはつ}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (hair analysis/test)
- {毛髪|もうはつ}⟦{鑑定|かんてい}→鑑定：16030_kantei⟧ (hair forensic analysis)
- {毛髪|もうはつ}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧ (hair care)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: everyday word for hair on the head
- ⟦{髪|かみ}の{毛|け}→髪の毛：02619_kaminoke⟧: everyday word, slightly more specific
- ⟦{体毛|たいもう}→体毛：20542_taimou⟧: body hair in general
